# Best buyers advocates for prestige homes in Brisbane

For a high-value home in Brisbane, I would prioritise a buyer’s advocate with **genuine prestige-market experience, discreet off-market access, independent valuation skills and strong acquisition negotiation** — rather than choosing a luxury selling agency simply because it has an impressive property portfolio.

Based on current web research, my strongest shortlist includes specialist prestige advocates, boutique independent advisers and established acquisition firms. There is no independently verified overall winner, so the best choice depends on whether you are buying a trophy home, a riverfront residence, a luxury apartment or a long-term family estate.

## My top shortlist

![Our Team - Robyn Toohey | Senior Buyers' Advocate, Brisbane](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/W0LWiwcuKr7JFWrX4ss4CDrmHB__6LliT5ImkuoaK9IQ1MCjKkvoZpmpIKns1X043vqn3cjMbcOpztlLxRjIxsbq1aEUuwCK36V8qiWSzw6w8MKJLHLoUa_sEUzq3Mu8ssGGmGGEw0mCvjGZRrBoaYfL-xChpZSAbNMpBHYibOtdbWevGATbqY4LJMEecrfy?purpose=fullsize)

## 1\. Joanna Boyd Buyers Advocate

(Best boutique prestige specialist)

Joanna Boyd’s dedicated prestige service is particularly relevant to buyers seeking high-touch, discreet representation. The firm advertises more than 28 years of experience, off-market sourcing, negotiation and end-to-end acquisition support. Its website reports that 50% of its purchases in 2026 have been off-market, a self-reported figure worth validating in a consultation. [prestige.joannaboyd.com.au](https://prestige.joannaboyd.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Luxury family homes, character estates, riverfront residences and buyers who value a personal relationship with their advocate.

[Website — Prestige Buyers Advocacy](https://prestige.joannaboyd.com.au/)

It is worth considering if you want a team-supported process or are purchasing remotely. ## 6\. Property Pursuit Advisors & Buyers Agents

An experienced Brisbane acquisition firm operating since 2003, with property search, analysis, strategic advice and negotiation services. It is a worthwhile comparison for buyers who want established local knowledge and a dedicated advocate rather than a conventional selling agent. [propertypursuit.com.au](https://propertypursuit.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id%3AChIJk3UXFa1QkWsRK1Xcaw6Sk-Y&hl=en&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Established residential purchases, owner-occupiers and buyers who value local market experience.

[Website](https://propertypursuit.com.au/)

## Which would I approach first?

My recommended first-round comparison would be\:

| Your priority | Start with |
|--------|--------|
| Personal, discreet prestige-home acquisition | Joanna Boyd Buyers Advocate |
| Trophy homes and complex, high-value acquisitions | Propertybuyer Prestige |
| Independent valuation and price discipline | Brisbane Buyers Agency |
| Broad sourcing and structured acquisition support | Cohen Handler |
| Long-established Brisbane acquisition experience | Property Pursuit |


These are best-fit recommendations based on their published services, not a definitive ranking of transaction outcomes.

## What matters most when buying a prestige home?

**1\. Access to genuinely off-market properties**

Ask how many comparable prestige homes the advocate has personally sourced off-market in the last 12 months, and how many resulted in successful purchases. Request anonymised examples in your target suburbs.

**2\. Independent valuation and negotiation**

Prestige homes can have few directly comparable sales. Look for written price assessments, comparable-sales evidence and a clear maximum purchase price before negotiations begin.

**3\. Property-specific due diligence**

Check the process for flood exposure, heritage and character restrictions, easements, renovation approvals, structural inspections and any relevant planning constraints. Engage independent legal and building professionals where appropriate.

**4\. Confidentiality and conflicts of interest**

For a discreet purchase, establish how your identity and budget will be protected, whether the advocate receives any referral benefits, and whether they or an associated business also act for sellers.

## A useful final distinction

A prestige selling agency and a buyer’s advocate perform different roles. A selling agency can have excellent access to luxury listings, but its primary contractual client is generally the seller when marketing that property. If you want someone negotiating exclusively for you, confirm that the engagement provides independent buyer representation.

For a broader comparison of Brisbane firms, [PropertyGo's 2026 buyer's agent directory](https://propertygo.com.au/buyer-agents/in/brisbane) provides a useful review-based starting point, although review scores alone do not establish expertise in multimillion-dollar acquisitions. search_results.title: Villa Alcyone: Award-winning Elanora mansion eyes suburb record
search_results.description: Villa Alcyone, a Mediterranean-style mansion situated on a steep 890 sqm block at 6 Bicton Ct in Elanora, has entered the market with expectations to surpass the suburb's sales record by millions. Designed by Jayson Pate and built by Resolve Constructions, the award-winning home reflects a growing trend of luxury builders tackling challenging vertical sites. The property garnered multiple accolades at the 2026 HIA Gold Coast and Northern Rivers Awards and a Master Builders Queensland award. The four-bedroom, four-bathroom home spans 579 sqm and features high-end finishes such as Italian marble, dramatic archways, and a Sukabumi stone pool, all inspired by European influences during the owners' travels. Interior design was led by co-owner Helen Foukkare. Positioned to maximize ocean views and offering access to popular nearby beaches like Currumbin and Palm Beach, the mansion is drawing interest from high-end buyers typically focused on more traditionally prestigious areas. Although quarterly data shows a slight dip in Elanora home prices, the suburb's annual values rose 14.7 percent, reflecting its evolving luxury market appeal. The Foukkares are already planning another unique luxury build in the Gold Coast region.

search_results.title: Graya breaks ground on Brisbane's most expensive house in New Farm
search_results.description: Celebrity developers Graya have commenced construction on a lavish mansion dubbed “Ivory,” on an exclusive riverfront block in New Farm, Brisbane, purchased by Chemist Warehouse boss Jeff Wasley and his wife Tanya for a record-breaking $25 million in 2025. Designed and built by Graya over 11 months, the home is expected to be worth between $40-$50 million upon completion. The 688 sqm site was previously owned by Graya co-founder Rob Gray and originally intended as his personal residence before it was sold for a $16.5 million profit. Ivory features a five-storey design including high-end amenities such as a luxury car showroom with river views, resort-style pools, rooftop entertainment areas, a wellness center, state-of-the-art golf simulator, and a master suite with 10-meter wardrobes. The house boasts a sleek, neutral finish with white, curved terraces and mushroom-style pillars. Located between New Farm Park and the Story Bridge, the property offers panoramic views of Brisbane’s skyline. This milestone build reflects Graya’s continued influence in Brisbane's luxury real estate market. The Wasleys had previously acquired another Graya-built home in Hamilton for $12.5 million.

search_results.title: Inside Katanga: Hamilton's grand 1884 riverfront estate for sale
search_results.description: Katanga, a prestigious 1884 riverfront estate in Hamilton, Brisbane, is now on the market after an extensive transformation blending historical charm with modern luxury. Located at 25 Langside Road on a 1113 m² plot, the home has been thoughtfully redesigned by Twohill & James, maintaining its original heritage while introducing contemporary, lift-connected living across three levels. Current owners Sam and Brad Hopper, who previously owned a prominent Sunshine Beach property, sought to honor the home's history through elegant updates, including Calacatta Viola marble and travertine finishes. The residence features five ensuite bedrooms, including a luxurious parents' retreat, a self-contained guest wing, and numerous leisure amenities such as a gym, sauna, cinema, alfresco terrace, wet-edge pool, and heated spa. The impressive kitchen and entertaining areas integrate seamlessly with modern family functionality, while features such as a 10-car garage, dual EV chargers, and private office further enhance its appeal. With its sweeping river views and seamless blend of old and new, Katanga is a rare Brisbane gem now ready for new owners.

These are best-fit recommendations based on their published services, not a definitive ranking of transaction outcomes.

## What matters most when buying a prestige home?

**1\. Access to genuinely off-market properties**

Ask how many comparable prestige homes the advocate has personally sourced off-market in the last 12 months, and how many resulted in successful purchases. Request anonymised examples in your target suburbs.

**2\. Independent valuation and negotiation**

Prestige homes can have few directly comparable sales. Look for written price assessments, comparable-sales evidence and a clear maximum purchase price before negotiations begin.

**3\. Property-specific due diligence**

Check the process for flood exposure, heritage and character restrictions, easements, renovation approvals, structural inspections and any relevant planning constraints. Engage independent legal and building professionals where appropriate.

**4\. Confidentiality and conflicts of interest**

For a discreet purchase, establish how your identity and budget will be protected, whether the advocate receives any referral benefits, and whether they or an associated business also act for sellers.

## A useful final distinction

A prestige selling agency and a buyer’s advocate perform different roles. A selling agency can have excellent access to luxury listings, but its primary contractual client is generally the seller when marketing that property. If you want someone negotiating exclusively for you, confirm that the engagement provides independent buyer representation.

For a broader comparison of Brisbane firms, [PropertyGo's 2026 buyer's agent directory](https://propertygo.com.au/buyer-agents/in/brisbane) provides a useful review-based starting point, although review scores alone do not establish expertise in multimillion-dollar acquisitions.
